model.matter: One electromagnetically and color-vectorlike Dirac (3,1,Y=-1/3); chiral global PQ with S of charge 1, X_DL=1, X_DR=0. SM neutral under PQ.
model.interaction: S Dbar_L (y D_R + b_j d_Rj), ordinary nondegenerate down Yukawa and nonzero heavy-light mixing; neutral singlet S supplies the whole anomalous row.
model.alternatives: Charged colorless Dirac singlet Q=1 with PQ difference +1; renormalizable second VEV with charges S=2,T=1 and phase-lock S^dagger T^2. Ordinary electromagnetic charge conserved.
model.matching: Only ordinary QCD generates the low-energy axion potential. No extra light colored degrees of freedom below matching, anomalous contact, explicit PQ breaking or independent electromagnetic axion coupling.

qcd.calibration: Grilli di Cortona et al., arXiv:1511.02867, p.4 and eq.41
qcd.enclosure: Use one published width for the photon subtraction and add the two mass-parameter widths linearly. These independent endpoint choices are a sensitivity rectangle, not a joint confidence interval.

admx.contract: Original conclusion and Fig.4 caption. Limit in frequency bins attaining the published DFSZ line outside the RF veto. Reference g_gamma is in alpha*g_gamma/(pi*f). Numeric power ratio cited only at a common f. Tests at fixed mass use the absolute bin limit; no reconstructed per-bin likelihood.

capp.contract: Boosted Maxwellian, Fig.4 and summary. The quoted coupling is approximate across the search, not a bin-specific calibration. Skip mode crossing and apply actual weaker bins pointwise.
